plugin_owner_unverified.en: The plugin owner could not be verified. Check it in the client.
plugin_owner_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法确认插件归属，请在所属客户端检查。

plugin_owner_candidate_required.en: Check the owning plugin for an update preview.
plugin_owner_candidate_required.zh-Hans: 检查所属插件并预览更新。

plugin_owner_ambiguous.en: More than one installation or scope matches this plugin. Resolve it in Claude.
plugin_owner_ambiguous.zh-Hans: 插件匹配到多个安装或作用域，请在 Claude 中确认。

codex_plugin_update_in_client.en: Update this plugin through Codex plugin management; an exact native update path is not verified.
codex_plugin_update_in_client.zh-Hans: 请通过 Codex 插件管理更新；当前尚未验证可精确更新的原生接口。

system_skill_update_client.en: This Skill is built into the client and follows client updates.
system_skill_update_client.zh-Hans: 这是客户端内置 Skill，随客户端升级。

plugin_scope_requires_client.en: This plugin scope must be managed in Claude.
plugin_scope_requires_client.zh-Hans: 此插件作用域需要在 Claude 中管理。

plugin_installation_unverified.en: The registered plugin path or installed version could not be verified.
plugin_installation_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法核实插件登记路径或已安装版本。

plugin_marketplace_unverified.en: The original marketplace could not be verified. Check it in Claude.
plugin_marketplace_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法核实原 marketplace，请在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_source_requires_client.en: This marketplace source or pin requires Claude plugin management.
plugin_source_requires_client.zh-Hans: 此 marketplace 来源或固定版本需要通过 Claude 插件管理处理。

plugin_source_changed.en: The plugin source changed. Check the original marketplace and preview again.
plugin_source_changed.zh-Hans: 插件来源已变化，请检查原 marketplace 后重新预览。

plugin_marketplace_modified.en: The marketplace has local changes. Preserve them before updating.
plugin_marketplace_modified.zh-Hans: marketplace 存在本地改动，请先保留这些改动。

plugin_components_require_review.en: This plugin contains components outside the supported Markdown Skill lane. Review it in Claude.
plugin_components_require_review.zh-Hans: 插件包含当前 Markdown Skill 更新范围之外的组件，请在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_content_unverified.en: The complete plugin content could not be verified.
plugin_content_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法核实完整插件内容。

plugin_local_modifications.en: Installed plugin files differ from the recorded commit. Preserve local changes before updating.
plugin_local_modifications.zh-Hans: 已安装插件文件与登记 commit 不符，请先保留本地改动。

plugin_version_ambiguous.en: The catalog and plugin manifest disagree on the version.
plugin_version_ambiguous.zh-Hans: 目录与插件 manifest 的版本不一致。

plugin_client_unavailable.en: A trusted Claude executable was not found.
plugin_client_unavailable.zh-Hans: 未找到可验证的 Claude 可执行文件。

plugin_client_update_unsupported.en: This Claude version does not expose the required update JSON interface.
plugin_client_update_unsupported.zh-Hans: 当前 Claude 版本未提供所需的更新 JSON 接口。

plugin_cached_snapshot_requires_reload.en: Update the whole plugin to the verified cached marketplace snapshot. Existing sessions need reload.
plugin_cached_snapshot_requires_reload.zh-Hans: 将整个插件更新到已核验的本地 marketplace 快照；现有会话需要重新加载插件。

plugin_version_requires_review.en: This version would downgrade the plugin or cannot be compared safely. Check it in Claude.
plugin_version_requires_review.zh-Hans: 此版本会使插件降级或无法可靠比较，请在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_uninstall_requires_client.en: Remove this plugin through its client.
plugin_uninstall_requires_client.zh-Hans: 请通过所属客户端卸载此插件。

plugin_owner_changed.en: The owning plugin changed after the preview.
plugin_owner_changed.zh-Hans: 预览后插件归属已变化。

plugin_version_unchanged_content_differs.en: Plugin content changed without a version change. Review it in Claude.
plugin_version_unchanged_content_differs.zh-Hans: 插件内容已变化，但版本未变，请在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_backup_failed.en: The original plugin could not be backed up. No owner update was started.
plugin_backup_failed.zh-Hans: 原插件备份失败，未启动所属客户端的更新。

plugin_installation_changed.en: The plugin or client changed after preview. Preview again.
plugin_installation_changed.zh-Hans: 预览后插件或客户端已变化，请重新预览。

plugin_update_not_activated.en: The expected version is not verified at the registered load path. Check the plugin in Claude.
plugin_update_not_activated.zh-Hans: 未能在登记加载路径确认目标版本，请在 Claude 中检查插件。

plugin_recovery_required.en: The plugin may be partly changed. Check its current state in Claude and preserve the backup.
plugin_recovery_required.zh-Hans: 插件可能发生了部分变化，请在 Claude 中检查当前状态并保留备份。

plugin_owner_failed_original_preserved.en: Claude could not complete the update. The original plugin is unchanged and backed up.
plugin_owner_failed_original_preserved.zh-Hans: Claude 未完成更新，原插件保持不变并已有备份。

plugin_content_verification_failed.en: Installed plugin content does not match the approved snapshot. Preserve the backup and check Claude.
plugin_content_verification_failed.zh-Hans: 已安装内容与确认的快照不符，请保留备份并在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_snapshot_installed_reload_require.en: The approved plugin snapshot is installed. Run /reload-plugins in existing Claude sessions or start a new session.
plugin_snapshot_installed_reload_require.zh-Hans: 确认的插件快照已安装。请在现有 Claude 会话运行 /reload-plugins，或开启新会话。

plugin_git_config_requires_review.en: The marketplace uses Git settings outside this update lane. Review them before updating.
plugin_git_config_requires_review.zh-Hans: marketplace 使用了当前更新范围之外的 Git 设置，请先检查。

plugin_settings_unverified.en: Claude plugin settings could not be verified.
plugin_settings_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法核实 Claude 插件设置。

plugin_disabled_requires_client.en: This plugin is disabled or its enabled state is unknown. Check it in Claude.
plugin_disabled_requires_client.zh-Hans: 插件已禁用或启用状态不明，请在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_marketplace_untracked.en: The marketplace is detached or differs from its recorded origin branch. Refresh or resolve it in Claude.
plugin_marketplace_untracked.zh-Hans: marketplace 处于分离状态或不同于登记的 origin 分支，请在 Claude 中刷新或处理。

plugin_source_history_changed.en: The installed plugin commit is outside the marketplace history. Check the source in Claude.
plugin_source_history_changed.zh-Hans: 已安装插件 commit 不在 marketplace 历史中，请在 Claude 中检查来源。

plugin_target_cache_exists.en: The existing target cache could not be verified against the approved plugin snapshot. Preserve it and review it in Claude.
plugin_target_cache_exists.zh-Hans: 现有目标缓存与确认的插件快照未能核实一致，请先保留并在 Claude 中检查。

plugin_marketplace_refresh_unsupported.en: This Claude version does not expose the required marketplace refresh JSON interface.
plugin_marketplace_refresh_unsupported.zh-Hans: 当前 Claude 版本未提供所需的 marketplace 刷新 JSON 接口。

plugin_remote_query_unavailable.en: The public marketplace branch could not be read. Retry, or explicitly preview the verified cached snapshot.
plugin_remote_query_unavailable.zh-Hans: 无法读取公开 marketplace 分支。可重试，或明确选择预览已核验的本地快照。

plugin_remote_snapshot_unavailable.en: The approved remote snapshot could not be downloaded and verified.
plugin_remote_snapshot_unavailable.zh-Hans: 无法下载并核实远端快照。

plugin_remote_changed_during_preview.en: The remote branch moved while preparing the preview. Preview again.
plugin_remote_changed_during_preview.zh-Hans: 准备预览时远端分支已变化，请重新预览。

plugin_remote_history_unverified.en: The current marketplace commit could not be verified in the remote history.
plugin_remote_history_unverified.zh-Hans: 无法在远端历史中确认当前 marketplace commit。

plugin_remote_verified_requires_reload.en: The public remote matches this verified snapshot. Update the whole plugin; existing sessions need reload.
plugin_remote_verified_requires_reload.zh-Hans: 公开远端与此核验快照一致。更新将作用于整个插件，现有会话需要重新加载。

plugin_marketplace_refresh_requires_conf.en: Refresh this marketplace to the approved commit, then update the whole plugin. Stop installation if the refreshed source differs.
plugin_marketplace_refresh_requires_conf.zh-Hans: 先将此 marketplace 刷新到确认的 commit，再更新整个插件；刷新后的来源不符时会停止安装。

plugin_marketplace_refresh_failed.en: Marketplace refresh was not completed. Review the reported source state before retrying.
plugin_marketplace_refresh_failed.zh-Hans: marketplace 刷新未完成，请先检查报告中的来源状态再重试。

plugin_marketplace_refresh_stopped_insta.en: Plugin installation stopped because the refreshed marketplace was not verified as the approved source. Marketplace changes may already have occurred; inspect the refresh details.
plugin_marketplace_refresh_stopped_insta.zh-Hans: 刷新后的 marketplace 未通过确认来源核验，插件安装已停止。marketplace 可能已发生变化，请查看刷新详情。

plugin_marketplace_approved_commit_verif.en: The marketplace was refreshed and verified at the approved commit.
plugin_marketplace_approved_commit_verif.zh-Hans: marketplace 已刷新并核实为确认的 commit。

plugin_update_network_isolation_unavaila.en: The system network-isolation command is unavailable. Update this plugin in Claude.
plugin_update_network_isolation_unavaila.zh-Hans: 系统网络隔离命令不可用，请在 Claude 中更新此插件。

plugin_skill_alias_version_bound.en: This Skill link points to a fixed cache version. Updating the plugin does not move the link; manage it in the client.
plugin_skill_alias_version_bound.zh-Hans: 此 Skill 链接固定指向一个缓存版本。更新插件不会迁移该链接，请在所属客户端处理。
